title: NASA Rally Sport Scrutineering Sheet

source.form: NASA Rally Sport Scrutineering Sheet (2013 Sandblast Rally sample)
source.rules: NASA Rally Sport GRR Section 3: Technical Regulations for Cars, v16.0

instructions: Team declaration: I represent the car and team listed above and I certify the roadworthiness and road legality of the above listed vehicle. 'Roadworthiness' includes, but is not limited to, the following items: FRONT END: headlights, driving lights, turn signals, parking lights, horn, windshield wipers and washers, rear view mirror. REAR END: tail lights, brake lights, license light, turn signals, backup lights. SUSPENSION AND RUNNING GEAR: steering linkage, suspension, shocks, wheel bearings, brakes, brake lines and hoses, wheels, tires, exhaust, service and parking brakes.

items.label: Helmet Expiration
items.accepts: Snell SA2015, SA2020 or newer; FIA 8860-2010, 8860-2018 or newer; FIA 8859-2015, 8859-2024 or newer; unmodified; not over 10 years old

items.label: H&N Gear
items.accepts: SFI 38.1 (not expired), FIA 8858-2002 or 8858-2010 (FIA tethers not past manufacture year + 5)

items.label: Suit Approved
items.accepts: FIA 8856-2000, 8856-2018 or newer, or FIA 1986; SFI 3-2A/5; SFI 3-2A/1 only with FIA- or SFI-spec fire-resistant underwear

items.label: Required Patches
items.accepts: Patches required by the series/event regulations sewn on the suit

items.label: Windshield/Windows
items.accepts: Laminated safety-glass windshield free of structural damage; polycarbonate replacements min. 1/8" allowing escape and rescue

items.label: Mud Flaps (rear and drive wheels)
items.accepts: Mud flaps on all wheels (current GRR; the form's 'rear and drive wheels' is older wording)

items.label: Tow Eyes (front and rear)
items.accepts: All-metal tow points front and rear on chassis/shell, golf-ball-size opening, painted/arrowed yellow, red or orange, reachable without crawling under the car

items.label: Safety related damage noted in log book
items.accepts: Safety-related damage and repairs recorded in the log book

items.label: First Aid Kit
items.accepts: In the cockpit with antiseptic, gauze, adhesive tape, arm sling, safety pins, scissors, 2 space blankets and first aid manual

items.label: Fire extinguisher 1x10BC or 2x5BC
items.accepts: Two or more hand-held extinguishers, min. 10 B:C each (or listed equivalents), in the cockpit, one within reach of a seated crew member; an on-board system does not count. The form's 1x10BC or 2x5BC is superseded

items.label: Fire extinguisher inspection date
items.accepts: Purchased, inspected or recharged within the preceding 2 years (all extinguishers within reach)

items.label: 3 DOT Triangles (1 near codriver)
items.accepts: 3 self-supporting reflective triangles, min. 14 in tip to opposite side, one within reach of a seated crew member

items.label: FIA 2 volume fuel splash shield
items.accepts: Two-volume (hatchback/wagon) cars: fuel-resistant, fire-retardant bulkhead fully separating tank, pump, filler and lines from the cockpit

items.label: Camera Mounts
items.accepts: Mounts cannot be struck by the crew; cameras over 0.5 lb secured at 2 points, non-elastic, non-plastic

items.label: Battery box, battery secure
items.accepts: Metal-to-metal mounts; positive terminal covered unless in a non-conductive box; sealed type if in the cockpit

items.label: Harness Expiration dates No exceptions
items.accepts: 5-, 6- or 7-point harness of current FIA or SFI spec, no mixed parts; SFI not past tag date, FIA usable through Dec 31 of the label year. No exceptions

items.label: Seats are secure
items.accepts: Firmly mounted to shell/chassis, fasteners min. 8 mm grade 5 / 8.8, no sliders

items.label: Seats are FIA cert or back brace
items.accepts: FIA 8855-1999, 8855-2021 or 8862-2009 (later two with their supplied mount); the form's 'back brace' option is no longer accepted

items.label: Roll Cage
items.accepts: Cage and NRS (or FIA) log book required; FIA-homologated or built to FIA App. J Art. 253 with NRS tube sizes; older log books per their issue-year rules

items.label: Roll Cage padding
items.accepts: FIA 8857-2001 Type A or SFI 45.1 wherever a helmet could contact the cage

items.label: Fuel / Oil Lines / Pumps
items.accepts: Lines and pumps secure, no leaks or chafing

items.label: Clean and Neat
items.accepts: Engine bay clean and neat

items.label: Brake Fluid Level
items.accepts: Reservoir at proper level, no leaks

items.label: Battery box, battery secure
items.accepts: Metal-to-metal mounts; positive terminal covered unless in a non-conductive box

items.label: Wiring
items.accepts: Wiring secure; battery primary wiring not routed between cage tubing and shell

items.label: Fluid Leaks
items.accepts: No fluid leaks

items.label: Fuel Tank / Fuel Cell
items.accepts: OEM tank in OEM location with OEM mounts, or SFI 28.3 / FIA FT3, FT3.5 or FT5 bladder cell in a metal container, vented outside, not more than 5 years from manufacture (or manufacturer recertified)

items.label: Bulkhead
items.accepts: Fuel-resistant, fire-retardant solid bulkhead fully separating tank, pump, filler, connections and vents from the cockpit; access panels sealed

items.label: Fuel Lines and Pumps
items.accepts: Lines through cockpit metal-cased, 200 psi, no cockpit connectors; pumps run only with engine running and behind a sealed metal bulkhead

items.label: Battery box, battery secure
items.accepts: Metal-to-metal mounts; relocated flooded batteries in a covered non-conductive box

items.label: Tow Rope
items.accepts: Kinetic recovery rope/strap, min. 3/4" thick and 19 ft long, no metal ends, stowed inside the car

items.label: Spares secure
items.accepts: Spare wheel and spares firmly secured; no loose articles

items.label: Size in mm
items.accepts: Open AWD Heavy: max. 34 mm internal (twin compressors 22.6 mm each); not required in other classes

items.label: Sealed? Y/N
items.accepts: Fasteners drilled and wired/sealed so the restrictor cannot be removed without removing the wire

items.label: External Y/N
items.accepts: Restrictor fixed to the compressor housing inlet, single piece, min. 3 mm long, all intake air through it

items.label: Exhaust noise level DBA
items.accepts: Max. 105 dBA at 2500 rpm, 18 in from the outlet, 45 degrees off centerline

items.label: Catalytic Converter (stock class only)
items.accepts: Functioning catalytic converter where the class requires it

items.label: Tread depth (tarmac rally only)
items.accepts: Tarmac events: 5.5 mm molded tread pattern, min. 1.6 mm over three quarters of the tread; no slicks or DOT-R tires

items.label: Weight
items.accepts: At or above the class minimum weight (no fuel, crew or crew equipment)

items.label: Race Number Correct
items.accepts: Assigned race number displayed correctly

items.label: Correct Number header and footer
items.accepts: Correct number header and footer decals

items.label: Event Sponsors
items.accepts: Event sponsor decals placed as instructed

items.label: RA / CARS stickers completely covered / removed
items.accepts: Other sanctioning bodies' stickers fully covered or removed

items.label: List any contingency stickers
items.accepts: Contingency stickers recorded

items.label: Log Book Sanctioning Body
items.accepts: NRS log book, or another body's log book accepted for inspection

items.label: Log Book Number
items.accepts: Log book number recorded

items.label: Address on last page of log book?
items.accepts: Current owner contact information recorded in the log book

items.label: Page for this event filled out by entrant?
items.accepts: Event page completed by the entrant

items.label: Correct homologation papers (Group A/N only)
items.accepts: Current FIA homologation papers for the car

items.label: VIN above matches logbook and car
items.accepts: VIN on this sheet matches the log book and the car's shell
